title: Robinhood crypto revenue -55%, Coinbase reports tonight: crypto earnings week

crypto earnings week 📉 robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% vs a year ago, coinbase reports after the us close thursday, strategy paused btc buys (still 848,517 btc) and ripple got final occ approval for a national trust bank. what are you watching in coinbase's numbers? 👇 not financial advice.
